data.name: GlobalImports_TemplateHint
data.value: Columns marked * require a cell value: ProductName, Category, Brand, Unit, SuggestedSku, SellingPrice, CostPrice. Optional: Description, Barcode (GS1 digits 8–14 with check digit when present; use SuggestedSku for codes like BAKERY000001), TaxHint, Tags, BusinessTypes, Status (blank = Draft). Keep header order. Multi-value Tags/BusinessTypes use |. Decimals: 25.50. Max 5 MB / 5000 rows.

data.name: GlobalImports_TemplateInstructions
data.value: 1) Download the CSV template. 2) Keep header names (the trailing * marks required values; you may leave * in place or remove it). 3) Fill required (*) columns; leave optional columns blank when unused. 4) Barcode is optional — digits only with a valid GS1 check digit; put merchant codes in SuggestedSku. 5) Remove or replace the SAMPLE rows. 6) Save as CSV UTF-8 and upload. 7) Import starts only after Confirm.
